<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script">
    <sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <abort_action>false</abort_action>
        <access>package_private</access>
        <action_delete>false</action_delete>
        <action_insert>true</action_insert>
        <action_query>false</action_query>

        <change_fields>false</change_fields>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <collection>x_delde_license_subscription</collection>
        <condition/>
        <description/>
        <execute_function>false</execute_function>
        <filter_condition table="x_delde_license_subscription">application_entitlementVALCHANGES^EQ<item endquery="false" field="application_entitlement" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/>
            <item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/>
        </filter_condition>
        <is_rest>false</is_rest>
        <message/>
        <name>Set associated roles</name>
        <order>100</order>
        <priority>100</priority>
        <rest_method/>
        <rest_method_text/>
        <rest_service/>
        <rest_service_text/>
        <rest_variables/>
        <role_conditions/>
        <script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/ ) {

    // Look up the licensed roles of the selected license families for the chosen role type.
    // Before rule: sets the field on current, no extra update.
    // Only when the entitlement or role type is set or changed, so roles added by hand
    // survive later saves such as the scanner's status updates.
    if (!current.isNewRecord() && !current.application_entitlement.changes() && !current.role_type.changes()) return;
    var families = current.getValue("application_entitlement");
    if (!families) return;

    var roleTypeId = current.role_type.id.toString();
    var roleGr = new GlideRecord("license_role");
    roleGr.addQuery("application.sys_id", "IN", families);
    var typeCondition = roleGr.addQuery("license_role_type", roleTypeId);
    if (roleTypeId == "business_stakeholder") {
        typeCondition.addOrCondition("license_role_type", "approver");
    }
    roleGr.query();
    var roles = [];
    while (roleGr.next()) {
        var name = roleGr.getValue("name");
        if (roles.indexOf(name) == -1) roles.push(name);
    }

    if (roles.length) {
        current.setValue("associated_roles", roles.join(","));
    } else {
        // Keep any manually entered roles when license_role has no mapping (e.g. roles in the "Unknown" family).
        gs.addInfoMessage("No licensed roles found in license_role for the selected families. Associated roles were left unchanged.");
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>public</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>x_delde_license.ScannerUtils</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description/>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>ScannerUtils</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var ScannerUtils = Class.create();
ScannerUtils.prototype = {

    SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE: 'x_delde_license_subscription',
    MONITOR_TABLE: 'x_delde_license_license_monitor',
    HISTORY_TABLE: 'x_delde_license_scan_history',
    PROPERTY_PREFIX: 'x_delde_license.',
    CHUNK_SIZE: 100,
    MAX_RECORDS_PER_USER_PER_TABLE: 50,

    /* Fields that identify the person a record is FOR (the customer / requester).
       A user who writes to or opens a record where they are named in one of these
       fields is acting on their own behalf, not as a fulfiller. */
    REQUESTER_FIELDS: ['caller_id', 'requested_for', 'opened_for', 'contact', 'consumer', 'requested_by'],

    STATUS: {
        NOT_INITIATED: '100',
        INITIATED: '200',
        IN_PROGRESS: '300',
        SKIPPED: '400',
        COMPLETED: '500',
        ERROR: '600'
    },

    /* Rank of license types and behaviour: a user counts once per module, at the highest level. */
    RANK: { 'Fulfiller': 3, 'Business Stakeholder': 2, 'Approver': 2, 'Requester': 1 },
    COUNTED_ELSEWHERE: /^Counted under \S+ \(higher license in the same module\)\. /,
    SEEN_IN: / \[from \S+\]$/,

    initialize: function() {
        this.lookbackDays = this._intProperty('lookback_days', 30);
        this.excludedRoles = gs.getProperty(this.PROPERTY_PREFIX + 'excluded_roles', 'admin');
        this.includeInheritedRoles = gs.getProperty(this.PROPERTY_PREFIX + 'include_inherited_roles', 'false') == 'true';
        this.checkFulfillerBelowFulfiller = gs.getProperty(this.PROPERTY_PREFIX + 'check_fulfiller_below_fulfiller', 'false') == 'true';
        this.ignoredAuditFields = this._listProperty('ignored_audit_fields', 'comments,watch_list,sys_tags');
        this.historyRetentionDays = this._intProperty('history_retention_days', 365);

        this.windowStart = new GlideDateTime();
        this.windowStart.addDaysUTC(-this.lookbackDays);

        this._roleTypeCache = {};
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  Scan orchestration                                                */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /**
     * Run a complete scan for one subscription. Sets status 300 while running,
     * 500 when done and 600 (with the error in scan_message) on failure.
     * @param subscriptionSysId {string}
     * @return {object|null} summary counts, or null on error
     */
    runScan: function(subscriptionSysId) {
        var sub = new GlideRecord(this.SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE);
        if (!sub.get(subscriptionSysId)) return null;

        var runId = gs.generateGUID();
        this._setScanState(sub, this.STATUS.IN_PROGRESS, 'Scan started ' + new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue());

        try {
            var tables = this._existingTables(sub.getValue('table_names'));
            var users = this.subscribedUsers(sub.getValue('associated_roles'));
            users = this._nonExcludedUsers(users, this.excludedRoles);

            // Below Fulfiller level the roles are read-only and ACLs stop fulfilling work, so the audit check is skipped
            var checkFulfiller = this.checkFulfillerBelowFulfiller ||
                (this.RANK[sub.getDisplayValue('role_type')] || 0) >= this.RANK.Fulfiller;
            var classification = this.classifyUsers(users, tables, { checkFulfiller: checkFulfiller });
            var summary = this.populateLicenseMonitor(sub, users, classification, runId);
            this._retirePreviousRuns(sub.getUniqueValue(), runId);
            var group = this.reconcileModule(sub.getUniqueValue());

            sub = this._reload(sub);
            sub.setValue('last_scanned', new GlideDateTime());
            this._setScanState(sub, this.STATUS.COMPLETED, this._summaryMessage(sub, runId));
            this._writeHistory(sub, runId);
            this._refreshSummaries(group, sub.getUniqueValue());
            return summary;
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('[License Scanner] Scan failed for ' + subscriptionSysId + ': ' + e + (e && e.stack ? '\n' + e.stack : ''));
            this._setScanState(this._reload(sub), this.STATUS.ERROR, 'Scan failed: ' + e);
            return null;
        }
    },

    /**
     * Kept for backwards compatibility with existing callers.
     */
    processScan: function(rolesStr, licenseDefinitionSysId, roleType) {
        return this.runScan(licenseDefinitionSysId);
    },

    /**
     * Mark scans that have been "In Progress" for too long as Error so they can run again.
     * @return {number} number of subscriptions reset
     */
    resetStuckScans: function() {
        var hours = this._intProperty('stuck_scan_hours', 6);
        var cutoff = new GlideDateTime();
        cutoff.addSeconds(-hours * 3600);

        var sub = new GlideRecord(this.SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE);
        sub.addQuery('scan_status', this.STATUS.IN_PROGRESS);
        sub.addQuery('sys_updated_on', '<', cutoff);
        sub.query();
        var count = 0;
        while (sub.next()) {
            this._setScanState(sub, this.STATUS.ERROR, 'Scan did not finish within ' + hours + ' hours and was reset.');
            count++;
        }
        return count;
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  Users in scope                                                    */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /**
     * Active, interactive users who hold at least one of the roles in their own right,
     * not only because another role they hold contains it.
     * @param associatedRoles {string} comma separated role names
     * @return {Array} user sys_ids
     */
    subscribedUsers: function(associatedRoles) {
        if (!associatedRoles) return [];

        // user -> {role name: true} for the associated roles the user holds
        var held = {};
        var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_user_has_role');
        // The flag is empty on many users: '=false' and '!=true' both skip empty values, so test for empty OR false
        gr.addEncodedQuery('role.nameIN' + associatedRoles + '^user.active=true^user.web_service_access_onlyISEMPTY^ORuser.web_service_access_only=false');
        gr.addNotNullQuery('user');
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            var u = gr.getValue('user');
            (held[u] = held[u] || {})[gr.role.name.toString()] = true;
        }
        var users = Object.keys(held);
        if (this.includeInheritedRoles || !users.length) return users;

        // A role only counts when the user does not also hold a licensed role that contains it
        // (for example sn_incident_read inside sn_incident_write). included_in_role is not
        // reliable for this, and inherited=true is also set for roles granted through groups.
        // Only containing roles that are themselves licensed (in any subscription) take over the license
        var licensed = {};
        var subs = new GlideRecord(this.SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE);
        subs.query();
        while (subs.next()) (subs.getValue('associated_roles') || '').split(',').forEach(function(r) { r = r.trim(); if (r) licensed[r] = true; });

        var parents = {};   // child role -> [parent roles]
        var all = {};
        var c = new GlideRecord('sys_user_role_contains');
        c.addQuery('contains.name', 'IN', associatedRoles);
        c.query();
        while (c.next()) {
            var child = c.contains.name.toString(), parent = c.role.name.toString();
            if (!parent || parent == child || !licensed[parent]) continue;
            (parents[child] = parents[child] || []).push(parent);
            all[parent] = true;
        }
        var parentNames = Object.keys(all);
        if (!parentNames.length) return users;

        var holdsParent = {};   // user -> {parent role: true}
        this._chunks(users).forEach(function(chunk) {
            var p = new GlideRecord('sys_user_has_role');
            p.addQuery('user', 'IN', chunk.join(','));
            p.addQuery('role.name', 'IN', parentNames.join(','));
            p.query();
            while (p.next()) (holdsParent[p.getValue('user')] = holdsParent[p.getValue('user')] || {})[p.role.name.toString()] = true;
        });
        return users.filter(function(u) {
            var mine = holdsParent[u] || {};
            return Object.keys(held[u]).some(function(role) {
                return !(parents[role] || []).some(function(par) { return mine[par]; });
            });
        });
    },

    /**
     * Remove users that hold any of the excluded roles.
     */
    _nonExcludedUsers: function(userArr, excludedRoles) {
        if (!excludedRoles || !userArr.length) return userArr;
        var excluded = {};
        this._chunks(userArr).forEach(function(chunk) {
            var ga = new GlideAggregate('sys_user_has_role');
            ga.addQuery('user', 'IN', chunk.join(','));
            ga.addQuery('role.name', 'IN', excludedRoles);
            ga.groupBy('user');
            ga.query();
            while (ga.next()) excluded[ga.getValue('user')] = true;
        });
        return userArr.filter(function(u) { return !excluded[u]; });
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  Classification                                                    */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /**
     * Classify every user as Fulfiller, Business Stakeholder or Requester.
     * Order of evidence: writes on others' records -> approvals -> views of others' records.
     * @param users {Array} user sys_ids
     * @param tables {Array} table names
     * @param options {object} optional: checkFulfiller (default true)
     * @return {object} userSysId -> {actingAs: string, evidence: string}
     */
    classifyUsers: function(users, tables, options) {
        var result = {};
        if (!users.length) return result;

        var userNames = this._userNames(users);       // sys_id -> user_name
        var byName = {};
        Object.keys(userNames).forEach(function(id) { byName[userNames[id]] = id; });

        var checkFulfiller = !options || options.checkFulfiller !== false;
        var fulfillers = checkFulfiller ? this._fulfillerEvidence(users, userNames, byName, tables) : {};
        var remaining = users.filter(function(u) { return !fulfillers[u]; });
        var approvers = this._approvalEvidence(remaining);
        remaining = remaining.filter(function(u) { return !approvers[u]; });
        var viewers = this._viewEvidence(remaining, tables);

        users.forEach(function(u) {
            if (fulfillers[u]) result[u] = { actingAs: 'Fulfiller', evidence: fulfillers[u] };
            else if (approvers[u]) result[u] = { actingAs: 'Business Stakeholder', evidence: approvers[u] };
            else if (viewers[u]) result[u] = { actingAs: 'Business Stakeholder', evidence: viewers[u] };
            else result[u] = { actingAs: 'Requester', evidence: 'No qualifying activity in the last ' + this.lookbackDays + ' days' };
        }, this);
        return result;
    },

    /**
     * Single-user wrapper kept for backwards compatibility.
     * @return {string} Fulfiller | Business Stakeholder | Requester
     */
    isActingAsFulfiller: function(userName, tableArr, userSysId) {
        var r = this.classifyUsers([userSysId], this._existingTables((tableArr || []).join(',')));
        return r[userSysId] ? r[userSysId].actingAs : 'Requester';
    },

    /**
     * Users who changed (sys_audit) records in the tables that are not their own.
     * @return {object} userSysId -> evidence string
     */
    _fulfillerEvidence: function(users, userNames, byName, tables) {
        var evidence = {};
        var names = users.map(function(u) { return userNames[u]; }).filter(Boolean);
        if (!names.length) return evidence;

        tables.forEach(function(table) {
            // user_name -> [documentkeys]
            var touched = {};
            this._chunks(names).forEach(function(chunk) {
                var ga = new GlideAggregate('sys_audit');
                ga.addQuery('tablename', table);
                ga.addQuery('user', 'IN', chunk.join(','));
                ga.addQuery('sys_created_on', '>=', this.windowStart);
                if (this.ignoredAuditFields.length) ga.addQuery('fieldname', 'NOT IN', this.ignoredAuditFields.join(','));
                ga.groupBy('user');
                ga.groupBy('documentkey');
                ga.query();
                while (ga.next()) {
                    var un = ga.getValue('user');
                    var id = byName[un];
                    if (!id || evidence[id]) continue;
                    touched[un] = touched[un] || [];
                    if (touched[un].length < this.MAX_RECORDS_PER_USER_PER_TABLE) touched[un].push(ga.getValue('documentkey'));
                }
            }, this);

            var docIds = [];
            Object.keys(touched).forEach(function(un) { docIds = docIds.concat(touched[un]); });
            if (!docIds.length) return;
            var owners = this._recordOwners(table, docIds);   // sys_id -> {ids:{}, createdBy:''}

            Object.keys(touched).forEach(function(un) {
                var id = byName[un];
                if (evidence[id]) return;
                for (var i = 0; i < touched[un].length; i++) {
                    var doc = touched[un][i];
                    var o = owners[doc];
                    if (o && !this._isOwner(o, id, un)) {
                        evidence[id] = 'Updated ' + table + ' ' + (o.number || doc) + ' owned by someone else';
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }, this);
        }, this);
        return evidence;
    },

    /**
     * Users who approved or rejected something within the scan window.
     * @return {object} userSysId -> evidence string
     */
    _approvalEvidence: function(users) {
        var evidence = {};
        this._chunks(users).forEach(function(chunk) {
            var ga = new GlideAggregate('sysapproval_approver');
            ga.addQuery('approver', 'IN', chunk.join(','));
            ga.addQuery('state', 'IN', 'approved,rejected');
            ga.addQuery('sys_updated_on', '>=', this.windowStart);
            ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
            ga.groupBy('approver');
            ga.query();
            while (ga.next()) {
                evidence[ga.getValue('approver')] = 'Approved or rejected ' + ga.getAggregate('COUNT') + ' item(s)';
            }
        }, this);
        return evidence;
    },

    /**
     * Users who opened records in the tables that are not their own.
     * Understands classic UI (table.do?sys_id=) and any workspace URL (/record/table/sys_id).
     * @return {object} userSysId -> evidence string
     */
    _viewEvidence: function(users, tables) {
        var evidence = {};
        if (!users.length || !tables.length) return evidence;
        var tableSet = {};
        tables.forEach(function(t) { tableSet[t] = true; });

        var viewed = {};   // user -> table -> [sys_ids]
        this._chunks(users).forEach(function(chunk) {
            var nav = new GlideRecord('sys_ui_navigator_history');
            nav.addQuery('user', 'IN', chunk.join(','));
            nav.addQuery('sys_created_on', '>=', this.windowStart);
            nav.query();
            while (nav.next()) {
                var parsed = this.parseRecordUrl(nav.getValue('url'));
                if (!parsed || !tableSet[parsed.table]) continue;
                var u = nav.getValue('user');
                viewed[u] = viewed[u] || {};
                var list = viewed[u][parsed.table] = viewed[u][parsed.table] || [];
                if (list.length < this.MAX_RECORDS_PER_USER_PER_TABLE && list.indexOf(parsed.sysId) == -1) list.push(parsed.sysId);
            }
        }, this);

        var userNames = this._userNames(Object.keys(viewed));
        tables.forEach(function(table) {
            var ids = [];
            Object.keys(viewed).forEach(function(u) { if (viewed[u][table]) ids = ids.concat(viewed[u][table]); });
            if (!ids.length) return;
            var owners = this._recordOwners(table, ids);
            Object.keys(viewed).forEach(function(u) {
                if (evidence[u] || !viewed[u][table]) return;
                var list = viewed[u][table];
                for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
                    var o = owners[list[i]];
                    if (o && !this._isOwner(o, u, userNames[u])) {
                        evidence[u] = 'Opened ' + table + ' ' + (o.number || list[i]) + ' owned by someone else';
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }, this);
        }, this);
        return evidence;
    },

    /**
     * Extract table and sys_id from a navigator history URL.
     * @param url {string}
     * @return {object|null} {table, sysId}
     */
    parseRecordUrl: function(url) {
        if (!url) return null;
        var u = url;
        try { u = decodeURIComponent(url); } catch (ignore) { /* keep raw */ }
        var m = u.match(/\/record\/([a-z0-9_]+)\/([0-9a-f]{32})/i);       // any workspace
        if (m) return { table: m[1], sysId: m[2] };
        m = u.match(/(?:^|[\/=?&])([a-z0-9_]+)\.do\?(?:[^#]*&)?sys_id=([0-9a-f]{32})/i); // classic UI
        if (m && !/_list$/.test(m[1])) return { table: m[1], sysId: m[2] };
        return null;
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  Monitor records and history                                       */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /**
     * Insert one monitor record per user for this run.
     * @return {object} counts per acting-as value
     */
    populateLicenseMonitor: function(sub, users, classification, runId) {
        var summary = { 'Fulfiller': 0, 'Business Stakeholder': 0, 'Requester': 0 };
        for (var i = 0; i < users.length; i++) {
            var c = classification[users[i]] || { actingAs: 'Requester', evidence: '' };
            var mon = new GlideRecord(this.MONITOR_TABLE);
            mon.initialize();
            mon.setValue('subscription', sub.getUniqueValue());
            mon.setValue('user', users[i]);
            mon.setValue('role_type', sub.getValue('role_type'));
            mon.setValue('acting_as', this.getSubRoleSysId(c.actingAs));
            mon.setValue('evidence', (c.evidence || '').substring(0, 1000));
            mon.setValue('scan_run', runId);
            mon.setValue('latest', true);
            mon.setValue('status', 'Completed');
            mon.insert();
            summary[c.actingAs] = (summary[c.actingAs] || 0) + 1;
        }
        return summary;
    },

    /**
     * Keep earlier runs as history (latest=false) and delete runs older than the retention period.
     */
    _retirePreviousRuns: function(subscriptionSysId, runId) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(this.MONITOR_TABLE);
        old.addQuery('subscription', subscriptionSysId);
        old.addEncodedQuery('scan_run!=' + runId + '^ORscan_runISEMPTY');
        old.addQuery('latest', true);
        old.setValue('latest', false);
        old.updateMultiple();

        if (this.historyRetentionDays > 0) {
            var cutoff = new GlideDateTime();
            cutoff.addDaysUTC(-this.historyRetentionDays);
            var purge = new GlideRecord(this.MONITOR_TABLE);
            purge.addQuery('subscription', subscriptionSysId);
            purge.addQuery('latest', false);
            purge.addQuery('sys_created_on', '<', cutoff);
            purge.deleteMultiple();
        }
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  One classification per user per module                            */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /**
     * Subscriptions that share at least one monitored table belong to the same module.
     * Within a module a user is counted once: in the subscription with the highest
     * license type they hold, with the highest behaviour seen in any of the module's
     * subscriptions. The other records stay as history (latest=false, status Skipped).
     * @param subscriptionSysId {string}
     * @return {Array} the module's subscriptions [{id, number, rank}]
     */
    reconcileModule: function(subscriptionSysId) {
        var group = this._moduleGroup(subscriptionSysId);
        if (!group.length) return group;

        var byUser = {};
        group.forEach(function(s) {
            s.runId = this._currentRun(s.id);
            if (!s.runId || (s.status == this.STATUS.IN_PROGRESS && s.id != subscriptionSysId)) return;   // reconciled when that scan finishes
            var mon = new GlideRecord(this.MONITOR_TABLE);
            mon.addQuery('subscription', s.id);
            mon.addQuery('scan_run', s.runId);
            mon.query();
            while (mon.next()) {
                var u = mon.getValue('user');
                var acting = mon.getDisplayValue('acting_as');
                (byUser[u] = byUser[u] || []).push({
                    sysId: mon.getUniqueValue(), sub: s,
                    actingAs: mon.getValue('acting_as'), actingRank: this.RANK[acting] || 0,
                    evidence: (mon.getValue('evidence') || '').replace(this.COUNTED_ELSEWHERE, ''),
                    latest: mon.getValue('latest') == '1' || mon.getValue('latest') == 'true',
                    status: mon.getValue('status'), rawEvidence: mon.getValue('evidence') || ''
                });
            }
        }, this);

        Object.keys(byUser).forEach(function(u) {
            var list = byUser[u];
            list.sort(function(a, b) {
                return (b.sub.rank - a.sub.rank) || (b.actingRank - a.actingRank) || (a.sub.number < b.sub.number ? -1 : 1);
            });
            var winner = list[0];
            var best = list.reduce(function(m, r) { return r.actingRank > m.actingRank ? r : m; }, winner);

            var w = { latest: true, status: 'Completed', evidence: winner.evidence };
            if (best !== winner) {
                w.acting_as = best.actingAs;
                w.evidence = best.evidence.replace(this.SEEN_IN, '') + ' [from ' + best.sub.number + ']';
            }
            this._updateMonitor(winner, w);

            for (var i = 1; i < list.length; i++) {
                this._updateMonitor(list[i], {
                    latest: false, status: 'Skipped',
                    evidence: 'Counted under ' + winner.sub.number + ' (higher license in the same module). ' + list[i].evidence
                });
            }
        }, this);
        return group;
    },

    /**
     * All subscriptions connected to this one through shared tables.
     */
    _moduleGroup: function(subscriptionSysId) {
        var all = [];
        var sub = new GlideRecord(this.SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE);
        sub.query();
        while (sub.next()) {
            var tables = {};
            (sub.getValue('table_names') || '').split(',').forEach(function(t) { t = t.trim(); if (t) tables[t] = true; });
            all.push({ id: sub.getUniqueValue(), number: sub.getValue('number'), status: sub.getValue('scan_status'),
                rank: this.RANK[sub.getDisplayValue('role_type')] || 0, tables: tables });
        }
        var shares = function(a, b) {
            for (var t in a.tables) if (b.tables[t]) return true;
            return false;
        };
        var start = all.filter(function(s) { return s.id == subscriptionSysId; });
        if (!start.length) return [];
        var group = [start[0]], queue = [start[0]];
        while (queue.length) {
            var cur = queue.shift();
            all.forEach(function(s) {
                if (group.indexOf(s) == -1 && shares(cur, s)) { group.push(s); queue.push(s); }
            });
        }
        return group;
    },

    /**
     * The scan_run of the subscription's most recent monitor record.
     */
    _currentRun: function(subscriptionSysId) {
        var mon = new GlideRecord(this.MONITOR_TABLE);
        mon.addQuery('subscription', subscriptionSysId);
        mon.addNotNullQuery('scan_run');
        mon.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        mon.setLimit(1);
        mon.query();
        return mon.next() ? mon.getValue('scan_run') : '';
    },

    _updateMonitor: function(rec, values) {
        var changed = values.latest != rec.latest || values.status != rec.status ||
            (values.evidence || '').substring(0, 1000) != rec.rawEvidence ||
            (values.acting_as && values.acting_as != rec.actingAs);
        if (!changed) return;
        var mon = new GlideRecord(this.MONITOR_TABLE);
        if (!mon.get(rec.sysId)) return;
        mon.setValue('latest', values.latest);
        mon.setValue('status', values.status);
        mon.setValue('evidence', (values.evidence || '').substring(0, 1000));
        if (values.acting_as) mon.setValue('acting_as', values.acting_as);
        mon.setWorkflow(false);
        mon.update();
    },

    /**
     * Scan message built from the run's records after reconciliation.
     */
    _runCounts: function(sub, runId) {
        var c = { total: 0, elsewhere: 0, 'Fulfiller': 0, 'Business Stakeholder': 0, 'Requester': 0 };
        var mon = new GlideRecord(this.MONITOR_TABLE);
        mon.addQuery('subscription', sub.getUniqueValue());
        mon.addQuery('scan_run', runId);
        mon.query();
        while (mon.next()) {
            c.total++;
            if (mon.getValue('status') == 'Skipped') { c.elsewhere++; continue; }
            var a = mon.getDisplayValue('acting_as');
            c[a] = (c[a] || 0) + 1;
        }
        return c;
    },

    _summaryMessage: function(sub, runId) {
        var c = this._runCounts(sub, runId);
        var tables = this._existingTables(sub.getValue('table_names')).length;
        return 'Scanned ' + c.total + ' users on ' + tables + ' tables (last ' + this.lookbackDays + ' days). ' +
            'Fulfiller: ' + c.Fulfiller + ', Business Stakeholder: ' + c['Business Stakeholder'] +
            ', Requester: ' + c.Requester + '.' +
            (c.elsewhere ? ' Counted under a higher license in the same module: ' + c.elsewhere + '.' : '') +
            ' Run ' + runId;
    },

    /**
     * One Scan History row per subscription per run, with the counts after reconciliation.
     * period_latest marks the last run of the subscription in each week, so trends do not
     * double count when a subscription is scanned more than once in a week.
     */
    _writeHistory: function(sub, runId) {
        var c = this._runCounts(sub, runId);
        var h = new GlideRecord(this.HISTORY_TABLE);
        h.addQuery('subscription', sub.getUniqueValue());
        h.addQuery('scan_run', runId);
        h.query();
        var isNew = !h.next();
        if (isNew) {
            h.initialize();
            h.setValue('subscription', sub.getUniqueValue());
            h.setValue('scan_run', runId);
            h.setValue('scanned_on', sub.getValue('last_scanned') || new GlideDateTime());
        }
        h.setValue('users', c.total);
        h.setValue('fulfiller', c.Fulfiller);
        h.setValue('business_stakeholder', c['Business Stakeholder']);
        h.setValue('requester', c.Requester);
        h.setValue('counted_elsewhere', c.elsewhere);
        if (isNew) h.setValue('period_latest', true);
        var id = isNew ? h.insert() : h.update();
        if (!isNew) return;

        // only the newest run in the same week counts for the trend
        var when = new GlideDateTime(h.getValue('scanned_on'));
        var from = new GlideDateTime(when); from.addDaysUTC(-7);
        var older = new GlideRecord(this.HISTORY_TABLE);
        older.addQuery('subscription', sub.getUniqueValue());
        older.addQuery('period_latest', true);
        older.addQuery('sys_id', '!=', id);
        older.addQuery('scanned_on', '>=', from);
        older.query();
        while (older.next()) {
            var o = new GlideDateTime(older.getValue('scanned_on'));
            if (o.getWeekOfYearUTC() == when.getWeekOfYearUTC() && o.getYearUTC() == when.getYearUTC()) {
                older.setValue('period_latest', false);
                older.update();
            }
        }
    },

    /**
     * Update the scan message of the other completed subscriptions in the module.
     */
    _refreshSummaries: function(group, exceptSysId) {
        (group || []).forEach(function(s) {
            if (s.id == exceptSysId || !s.runId) return;
            var sub = new GlideRecord(this.SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE);
            if (!sub.get(s.id) || sub.getValue('scan_status') != this.STATUS.COMPLETED) return;
            sub.setValue('scan_message', this._summaryMessage(sub, s.runId).substring(0, 1000));
            sub.setWorkflow(false);
            sub.update();
            this._writeHistory(sub, s.runId);
        }, this);
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  Helpers                                                           */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /**
     * Get license_role_type sys_id by name (cached).
     */
    getSubRoleSysId: function(roleName) {
        if (this._roleTypeCache[roleName] !== undefined) return this._roleTypeCache[roleName];
        var rt = new GlideRecord('license_role_type');
        rt.addQuery('name', roleName);
        rt.setLimit(1);
        rt.query();
        this._roleTypeCache[roleName] = rt.next() ? rt.getUniqueValue() : '';
        return this._roleTypeCache[roleName];
    },

    /**
     * For a set of record sys_ids, who the records belong to.
     * @return {object} sys_id -> {ids: {userSysId:true}, createdBy: user_name, number}
     */
    _recordOwners: function(table, sysIds) {
        var owners = {};
        if (!gs.tableExists(table)) return owners;
        var probe = new GlideRecord(table);
        var fields = this.REQUESTER_FIELDS.filter(function(f) { return probe.isValidField(f); });

        this._chunks(sysIds).forEach(function(chunk) {
            var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
            gr.addQuery('sys_id', 'IN', chunk.join(','));
            gr.query();
            while (gr.next()) {
                var o = { ids: {}, createdBy: gr.getValue('sys_created_by'), number: gr.isValidField('number') ? gr.getValue('number') : '' };
                fields.forEach(function(f) { var v = gr.getValue(f); if (v) o.ids[v] = true; });
                o.hasRequester = Object.keys(o.ids).length > 0;
                owners[gr.getUniqueValue()] = o;
            }
        });
        return owners;
    },

    /**
     * True when the user is the person the record is for. Falls back to the creator
     * when the record has no requester-type field filled in.
     */
    _isOwner: function(owner, userSysId, userName) {
        if (owner.hasRequester) return !!owner.ids[userSysId];
        return owner.createdBy == userName;
    },

    _userNames: function(userIds) {
        var map = {};
        this._chunks(userIds).forEach(function(chunk) {
            var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
            u.addQuery('sys_id', 'IN', chunk.join(','));
            u.query();
            while (u.next()) map[u.getUniqueValue()] = u.getValue('user_name');
        });
        return map;
    },

    _existingTables: function(tableNames) {
        if (!tableNames) return [];
        var seen = {};
        return tableNames.split(',').map(function(t) { return t.trim(); }).filter(function(t) {
            if (!t || seen[t] || !gs.tableExists(t)) return false;
            seen[t] = true;
            return true;
        });
    },

    _setScanState: function(sub, status, message) {
        sub.setValue('scan_status', status);
        sub.setValue('scan_message', (message || '').substring(0, 1000));
        sub.update();
    },

    _reload: function(gr) {
        var fresh = new GlideRecord(gr.getTableName());
        fresh.get(gr.getUniqueValue());
        return fresh;
    },

    _chunks: function(arr) {
        var out = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i += this.CHUNK_SIZE) out.push(arr.slice(i, i + this.CHUNK_SIZE));
        return out;
    },

    _intProperty: function(name, fallback) {
        var v = parseInt(gs.getProperty(this.PROPERTY_PREFIX + name, String(fallback)), 10);
        return isNaN(v) ? fallback : v;
    },

    _listProperty: function(name, fallback) {
        return gs.getProperty(this.PROPERTY_PREFIX + name, fallback).split(',')
            .map(function(s) { return s.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    },

    removeDuplicates: function(arr) {
        return (arr || []).filter(function(item, index) { return arr.indexOf(item) === index; });
    },

    type: 'ScannerUtils'
};
]]></script>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($scope, $element, $window, $timeout) {
    /* License Scanner - License usage widget (client). All numbers come from c.data; this only filters and sums. */
    var c = this;
    var MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
    c.selected = 'all';
    c.loading = false;

    c.select = function(key) {
        c.selected = key;
        recompute();
    };

    c.refresh = function() {
        c.loading = true;
        c.server.get({ action: 'refresh' }).then(function(r) {
            angular.extend(c.data, r.data);
            c.loading = false;
            recompute();
        });
    };

    function shownModules() {
        return (c.data.modules || []).filter(function(m) { return c.selected === 'all' || m.key === c.selected; });
    }

    function recompute() {
        if (!c.data.allowed) return;
        var mods = shownModules();
        var rows = [], total = 0, atLevel = 0, downgrade = 0, notUsed = 0, reviewTotal = 0, subIds = [];
        var weeks = c.data.weeks || [];
        var series = weeks.map(function() { return null; });

        mods.forEach(function(m) {
            m.subs.forEach(function(s) {
                var users = s.f + s.bs + s.r;
                total += users;
                atLevel += s.type === 'Fulfiller' ? s.f : s.bs;
                if (s.type === 'Fulfiller') { downgrade += s.bs; reviewTotal += s.bs + s.r; }
                notUsed += s.r;
                subIds.push(s.id);
                (s.req || []).forEach(function(v, i) { if (v !== null) series[i] = (series[i] || 0) + v; });
                rows.push({
                    module: m.label, name: s.name, type: s.type, scanned: s.scanned, users: users, r: s.r,
                    isFulfiller: s.type === 'Fulfiller',
                    fW: pct(s.f, users), bW: pct(s.bs, users), rW: pct(s.r, users),
                    f: s.f, bs: s.bs,
                    aria: s.name + ', ' + s.type + ': ' + s.f + ' Fulfiller, ' + s.bs + ' Business Stakeholder, ' + s.r + ' Requester'
                });
            });
        });

        c.kpi = {
            total: total, atLevel: atLevel, atLevelPct: total ? Math.round(atLevel / total * 100) : 0,
            downgrade: downgrade, notUsed: notUsed, reviewTotal: reviewTotal
        };
        c.rows = rows;
        c.trend = buildTrend(series, weeks);
        c.review = (c.data.review || []).filter(function(u) { return c.selected === 'all' || u.module === c.selected; }).slice(0, 5);
        c.reviewLink = c.data.links.monitor + encodeURIComponent('latest=true^role_type=' + c.data.fulfillerId +
            '^acting_as!=' + c.data.fulfillerId + (subIds.length ? '^subscriptionIN' + subIds.join(',') : ''));
    }

    function pct(n, of) { return of ? (n / of * 100).toFixed(2) + '%' : '0%'; }

    function buildTrend(series, weeks) {
        var idx = [], vals = [];
        series.forEach(function(v, i) { if (v !== null) { idx.push(i); vals.push(v); } });
        if (vals.length < 2) return { enough: false, last: vals.length ? vals[0] : 0 };
        var max = Math.max.apply(null, vals), min = Math.min.apply(null, vals), span = Math.max(1, max - min);
        var n = Math.max(1, weeks.length - 1);
        var pts = vals.map(function(v, k) { return (idx[k] * 600 / n).toFixed(1) + ',' + (20 + (max - v) / span * 150).toFixed(1); });
        var first = vals[0], last = vals[vals.length - 1], diff = last - first;
        return {
            enough: true, first: first, last: last,
            change: diff === 0 ? 'No change' : (diff < 0 ? '−' : '+') + Math.abs(diff) + ' in ' + vals.length + ' weeks',
            down: diff < 0,
            line: pts.join(' '),
            area: pts.join(' ') + ' ' + (idx[idx.length - 1] * 600 / n).toFixed(1) + ',170 ' + (idx[0] * 600 / n).toFixed(1) + ',170',
            labels: [label(weeks[idx[0]]), label(weeks[Math.floor((idx[0] + idx[idx.length - 1]) / 2)]), label(weeks[idx[idx.length - 1]])],
            aria: 'Unused licenses went from ' + first + ' to ' + last + ' over ' + vals.length + ' weeks'
        };
    }

    function label(isoDate) {
        if (!isoDate) return '';
        var p = isoDate.split('-');
        return parseInt(p[2], 10) + ' ' + MONTHS[parseInt(p[1], 10) - 1];
    }

    recompute();

    /* Employee Center's left navigation rail is position:fixed and can cover the widget. Measure and move clear. */
    var RAIL = '.parent-menu-container.main-container, .skeleton-loader-container.main-container';
    var GAP = 16, observer = null, tries = 0, retry = null;
    function clearRail() {
        var root = $element[0].querySelector('.lsw-widget');
        if (!root) return;
        root.style.marginLeft = '';
        var rail = $window.document.querySelector(RAIL);
        if (!rail || !$window.document.body.classList.contains('left-nav-desktop')) return;
        var overlap = rail.getBoundingClientRect().right - root.getBoundingClientRect().left;
        if (overlap > 0) root.style.marginLeft = (overlap + GAP) + 'px';
    }
    function retryLoop() {
        clearRail();
        if (++tries < 10) retry = $timeout(retryLoop, 300);
    }
    $timeout(function() {
        retryLoop();
        var rail = $window.document.querySelector(RAIL);
        if (rail && $window.ResizeObserver) { observer = new $window.ResizeObserver(clearRail); observer.observe(rail); }
    });
    angular.element($window).on('resize', clearRail);
    $scope.$on('$destroy', function() {
        angular.element($window).off('resize', clearRail);
        if (observer) observer.disconnect();
        if (retry) $timeout.cancel(retry);
    });
};
]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* License Scanner - License usage widget. Every class is prefixed lsw-; no global rules. */
.lsw-widget, .lsw-widget *, .lsw-widget *::before, .lsw-widget *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

.lsw-widget {

  border-radius: var(--lsw-radius);

}
.lsw-widget > div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; }

.lsw-h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--lsw-ink); }
.lsw-h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--lsw-ink); }
.lsw-muted { margin: 0; color: var(--lsw-muted); font-size: 14px; }
.lsw-small { font-size: 13px; }
.lsw-strong { font-weight: 700; }
.lsw-c-bs { color: var(--lsw-bs-text); }
.lsw-c-req { color: var(--lsw-req-text); }
.lsw-good { color: var(--lsw-good); }

.lsw-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; }
.lsw-title { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.lsw-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }
.lsw-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--lsw-f); text-decoration: none; }
.lsw-link:hover, .lsw-link:focus { color: #163A73; text-decoration: underline; }
.lsw-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 22px; border: 1px solid #C9CFDB; background: var(--lsw-card); color: var(--lsw-ink); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }
.lsw-btn-ghost[disabled] { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; }

.lsw-filters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.lsw-pill { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 22px; border: 1px solid #C9CFDB; background: var(--lsw-card); color: var(--lsw-ink); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }
.lsw-pill:hover { border-color: var(--lsw-ink-2); }
.lsw-pill-on, .lsw-pill-on:hover { background: var(--lsw-ink); border-color: var(--lsw-ink); color: #FFFFFF; }
.lsw-pill:focus-visible, .lsw-btn-ghost:focus-visible, .lsw-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7DB1EE; outline-offset: 2px; }

.lsw-card { background: var(--lsw-card); border-radius: var(--lsw-radius); padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(29, 36, 51, 0.08); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.lsw-card-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }

.lsw-kpis { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; }
.lsw-kpi { flex: 1 1 220px; padding: 20px; gap: 8px; }
.lsw-kpi-label { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--lsw-muted); }
.lsw-kpi-n { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.1; }
.lsw-kpi-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; }
.lsw-kpi-pct { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--lsw-f); }
.lsw-kpi-change { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--lsw-muted); }

.lsw-split { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: stretch; }
.lsw-bysub { flex: 999 1 560px; min-width: 0; }
.lsw-trend { flex: 1 1 320px; min-width: 0; }

.lsw-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--lsw-ink-2); }
.lsw-legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.lsw-sw { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; }
.lsw-bg-f { background: var(--lsw-f); }
.lsw-bg-bs { background: var(--lsw-bs); }
.lsw-bg-req { background: var(--lsw-req); }

.lsw-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.lsw-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.lsw-row-top { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.lsw-row-name { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; font-size: 14px; }
.lsw-badge { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 10px; white-space: nowrap; }
.lsw-badge-f { background: #E6EEF9; color: var(--lsw-f); }
.lsw-badge-bs { background: #EAF3FD; color: var(--lsw-bs-text); }
.lsw-bar { display: flex; gap: 2px; height: 12px; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; background: #EDEFF3; }
.lsw-seg { height: 100%; }

.lsw-trend-n { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; }
.lsw-chart { display: block; width: 100%; height: 180px; margin-top: 12px; }
.lsw-axis { stroke: var(--lsw-line); stroke-width: 1; }
.lsw-grid { stroke: var(--lsw-line-2); stroke-width: 1; }
.lsw-area { fill: var(--lsw-req); fill-opacity: 0.16; }
.lsw-line { fill: none; stroke: #D07A1F; stroke-width: 3; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; }
.lsw-axis-labels { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12px; color: var(--lsw-muted); }

.lsw-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
.lsw-table { width: 100%; min-width: 720px; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 14px; }
.lsw-table th { text-align: left; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--lsw-muted); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--lsw-line); }
.lsw-table td { padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--lsw-line-2); color: var(--lsw-ink-2); vertical-align: top; }
.lsw-act { display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 12px; white-space: nowrap; }
.lsw-act-req { background: #FDF0E1; color: #8F4C0A; }
.lsw-act-bs { background: #EAF3FD; color: var(--lsw-bs-text); }

.lsw-denied { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 24px; background: var(--lsw-card); border-radius: var(--lsw-radius); }

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .lsw-widget { padding: 20px 12px 32px; }
  .lsw-h1 { font-size: 24px; }
  .lsw-kpi-n { font-size: 28px; }
}
</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description>License Scanner: license usage per module, unused licenses trend and users to review. Requires usage_admin.</description><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>false</has_preview><id>x-delde-license-usage</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {  }]]></link><name>License usage</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function() {
    /* License Scanner - License usage widget (server, ES5).
       Builds plain JSON from Scan History and License Monitor. All numbers are counted here. */
    var FULFILLER = '1783b4032323001004402d0d96bf65e1';   // license_role_type Fulfiller, same sys_id on every instance
    var RANK = { 'Fulfiller': 3, 'Business Stakeholder': 2, 'Approver': 2, 'Requester': 1 };
    var WEEKS = 12;

    data.allowed = gs.hasRole('usage_admin');
    if (!data.allowed) return;

    var built = buildData();
    for (var k in built) data[k] = built[k];
    return;

    function buildData() {
        var out = {};

        // 1. Active subscriptions with their tables
        var subs = [], byId = {};
        var s = new GlideRecord('x_delde_license_subscription');
        s.addActiveQuery();
        s.orderBy('number');
        s.query();
        var lastScanned = '';
        while (s.next()) {
            var tables = {};
            (s.getValue('table_names') || '').split(',').forEach(function(t) { t = t.trim(); if (t) tables[t] = true; });
            var type = s.getDisplayValue('role_type') || '';
            var rec = { id: s.getUniqueValue(), number: s.getValue('number'), name: s.getValue('name'), type: type,
                rank: RANK[type] || 0, tables: tables, scanned: false, f: 0, bs: 0, r: 0, elsewhere: 0, req: [] };
            subs.push(rec); byId[rec.id] = rec;
            var ls = s.getValue('last_scanned');
            if (ls && ls > lastScanned) lastScanned = ls;
        }

        // 2. Modules: subscriptions that share at least one table (same rule as the scanner)
        var moduleOf = {}, modules = [];
        subs.forEach(function(start) {
            if (moduleOf[start.id]) return;
            var key = 'm' + modules.length, group = [start], queue = [start];
            moduleOf[start.id] = key;
            while (queue.length) {
                var cur = queue.shift();
                subs.forEach(function(o) {
                    if (moduleOf[o.id]) return;
                    for (var t in cur.tables) {
                        if (o.tables[t]) { moduleOf[o.id] = key; group.push(o); queue.push(o); break; }
                    }
                });
            }
            group.sort(function(a, b) { return (b.rank - a.rank) || (a.number < b.number ? -1 : 1); });
            modules.push({ key: key, label: moduleLabel(group), subs: group });
        });

        // 3. Latest counts per subscription from Scan History
        var h = new GlideRecord('x_delde_license_scan_history');
        h.addQuery('subscription', 'IN', Object.keys(byId).join(','));
        h.orderByDesc('scanned_on');
        h.query();
        var seen = {};
        while (h.next()) {
            var sid = h.getValue('subscription');
            if (seen[sid]) continue;
            seen[sid] = true;
            var sub = byId[sid];
            sub.scanned = true;
            sub.f = toInt(h.getValue('fulfiller'));
            sub.bs = toInt(h.getValue('business_stakeholder'));
            sub.r = toInt(h.getValue('requester'));
            sub.elsewhere = toInt(h.getValue('counted_elsewhere'));
        }

        // 4. Weekly Requester trend (newest run per week), carried forward over missing weeks
        var weeks = weekStarts(WEEKS);
        var from = new GlideDateTime(weeks[0] + ' 00:00:00');
        var t = new GlideRecord('x_delde_license_scan_history');
        t.addQuery('subscription', 'IN', Object.keys(byId).join(','));
        t.addQuery('period_latest', true);
        t.addQuery('scanned_on', '>=', from);
        t.orderBy('scanned_on');
        t.query();
        var perWeek = {};   // sid -> week -> requester
        while (t.next()) {
            var wk = weekOf(new GlideDateTime(t.getValue('scanned_on')));
            var id = t.getValue('subscription');
            (perWeek[id] = perWeek[id] || {})[wk] = toInt(t.getValue('requester'));
        }
        subs.forEach(function(sub) {
            var last = null, series = [];
            weeks.forEach(function(w) {
                if (perWeek[sub.id] && perWeek[sub.id][w] !== undefined) last = perWeek[sub.id][w];
                series.push(last);
            });
            sub.req = series;
        });

        // 5. Users to review: Fulfiller license, not acting as Fulfiller
        var review = [];
        var m = new GlideRecord('x_delde_license_license_monitor');
        m.addQuery('latest', true);
        m.addQuery('role_type', FULFILLER);
        m.addQuery('acting_as', '!=', FULFILLER);
        m.addQuery('subscription', 'IN', Object.keys(byId).join(','));
        m.orderBy('acting_as');
        m.orderBy('user.name');
        m.setLimit(500);
        m.query();
        while (m.next()) {
            var subId = m.getValue('subscription');
            review.push({ user: m.getDisplayValue('user'), sub: subId, subName: byId[subId] ? byId[subId].name : '',
                module: moduleOf[subId], acting: m.getDisplayValue('acting_as'), evidence: m.getValue('evidence') || '' });
        }

        out.modules = modules.map(function(mod) {
            return { key: mod.key, label: mod.label, subs: mod.subs.map(function(x) {
                return { id: x.id, name: x.name, type: x.type, scanned: x.scanned,
                    f: x.f, bs: x.bs, r: x.r, elsewhere: x.elsewhere, req: x.req };
            }) };
        });
        out.modules.sort(function(a, b) { return total(b) - total(a); });
        out.weeks = weeks;
        out.review = review;
        out.subscriptionCount = subs.length;
        out.lastScanned = lastScanned ? new GlideDateTime(lastScanned).getDisplayValue() : '';
        out.lookbackDays = gs.getProperty('x_delde_license.lookback_days', '30');
        out.links = {
            dashboard: '/now/platform-analytics-workspace/dashboards/params/edit/false/sys-id/6a774bc9878b36149b22a7980cbb3505',
            monitor: '/x_delde_license_license_monitor_list.do?sysparm_query='
        };
        out.fulfillerId = FULFILLER;
        return out;
    }

    function moduleLabel(group) {
        // Label from the highest-ranked subscription, without its license-type suffix
        var n = group[0].name || '';
        return n.replace(/\s*-\s*(Fulfiller|Business Stakeholder)\s*$/i, '') || n;
    }
    function total(mod) {
        var n = 0;
        mod.subs.forEach(function(x) { n += x.f + x.bs + x.r; });
        return n;
    }
    function toInt(v) { var n = parseInt(v, 10); return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n; }
    function weekOf(gdt) {
        var d = new GlideDateTime(gdt);
        d.addDaysUTC(1 - d.getDayOfWeekUTC());   // back to Monday
        return d.getValue().substring(0, 10);
    }
    function weekStarts(n) {
        var cur = weekOf(new GlideDateTime()), out = [];
        var d = new GlideDateTime(cur + ' 00:00:00');
        d.addDaysUTC(-7 * (n - 1));
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { out.push(d.getValue().substring(0, 10)); d.addDaysUTC(7); }
        return out;
    }
})();
]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>malimooti.cadmin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-26 20:47:53</sys_created_on><sys_id>236fa629c3fcd710c8fa98ec05013121</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>License usage</sys_name><sys_package display_value="License Scanner" source="x_delde_license">1220c0668775f6509b22a7980cbb35a0</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="License Scanner">1220c0668775f6509b22a7980cbb35a0</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_236fa629c3fcd710c8fa98ec05013121</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>malimooti.cadmin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-26 20:48:36</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="lsw-widget">

  <div class="lsw-denied" ng-if="!c.data.allowed">
    <h2 class="lsw-h2">License usage</h2>
    <p class="lsw-muted">You need the usage_admin role to see license usage.</p>
  </div>

  <div ng-if="c.data.allowed">
    <div class="lsw-head">
      <div class="lsw-title">
        <h1 class="lsw-h1">License usage</h1>
        <p class="lsw-muted">
          <span ng-if="c.data.lastScanned">Latest scan {{c.data.lastScanned}} · </span>{{c.data.subscriptionCount}} license subscriptions · activity in the last {{c.data.lookbackDays}} days
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="lsw-actions">
        <button type="button" class="lsw-btn-ghost" ng-click="c.refresh()" ng-disabled="c.loading" aria-label="Refresh">
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-2.64-6.36"></path><path d="M21 4v5h-5"></path></svg>
          <span>{{c.loading ? 'Refreshing' : 'Refresh'}}</span>
        </button>
        <a class="lsw-link" ng-href="{{c.data.links.dashboard}}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open full dashboard
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"></path></svg>
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="lsw-filters" role="group" aria-label="Module">
      <button type="button" class="lsw-pill" ng-class="{'lsw-pill-on': c.selected === 'all'}" aria-pressed="{{c.selected === 'all'}}" ng-click="c.select('all')">All modules</button>
      <button type="button" class="lsw-pill" ng-repeat="m in c.data.modules" ng-class="{'lsw-pill-on': c.selected === m.key}" aria-pressed="{{c.selected === m.key}}" ng-click="c.select(m.key)">{{m.label}}</button>
    </div>

    <div class="lsw-kpis">
      <section class="lsw-card lsw-kpi">
        <h2 class="lsw-kpi-label">Licensed users</h2>
        <div class="lsw-kpi-n">{{c.kpi.total | number}}</div>
        <p class="lsw-muted lsw-small">Counted once per module</p>
      </section>
      <section class="lsw-card lsw-kpi">
        <h2 class="lsw-kpi-label">Used at license level</h2>
        <div class="lsw-kpi-row"><span class="lsw-kpi-n">{{c.kpi.atLevel | number}}</span><span class="lsw-kpi-pct">{{c.kpi.atLevelPct}}%</span></div>
        <p class="lsw-muted lsw-small">Act as the license they hold</p>
      </section>
      <section class="lsw-card lsw-kpi">
        <h2 class="lsw-kpi-label">Possible downgrades</h2>
        <div class="lsw-kpi-n lsw-c-bs">{{c.kpi.downgrade | number}}</div>
        <p class="lsw-muted lsw-small">Fulfiller license, Business Stakeholder use</p>
      </section>
      <section class="lsw-card lsw-kpi">
        <h2 class="lsw-kpi-label">Not used</h2>
        <div class="lsw-kpi-row">
          <span class="lsw-kpi-n lsw-c-req">{{c.kpi.notUsed | number}}</span>
          <span class="lsw-kpi-change" ng-if="c.trend.enough" ng-class="{'lsw-good': c.trend.down}">{{c.trend.change}}</span>
        </div>
        <p class="lsw-muted lsw-small">Hold a license, act as Requester</p>
      </section>
    </div>

    <div class="lsw-split">
      <section class="lsw-card lsw-bysub" aria-labelledby="lsw-bysub-h">
        <div class="lsw-card-head">
          <h2 class="lsw-h2" id="lsw-bysub-h">By subscription</h2>
          <div class="lsw-legend">
            <span><i class="lsw-sw lsw-bg-f"></i>Fulfiller</span>
            <span><i class="lsw-sw lsw-bg-bs"></i>Business Stakeholder</span>
            <span><i class="lsw-sw lsw-bg-req"></i>Requester</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="lsw-rows">
          <div class="lsw-row" ng-repeat="row in c.rows">
            <div class="lsw-row-top">
              <div class="lsw-row-name">
                <span class="lsw-strong" title="{{row.name}}">{{row.module}}</span>
                <span class="lsw-badge" ng-class="row.isFulfiller ? 'lsw-badge-f' : 'lsw-badge-bs'">{{row.type}}</span>
              </div>
              <span class="lsw-muted lsw-small" ng-if="row.scanned">{{row.users | number}} users · <strong class="lsw-c-req">{{row.r | number}} not used</strong></span>
              <span class="lsw-muted lsw-small" ng-if="!row.scanned">Not scanned yet</span>
            </div>
            <div class="lsw-bar" role="img" aria-label="{{row.aria}}">
              <div class="lsw-seg lsw-bg-f" ng-if="row.f" ng-style="{width: row.fW}"></div>
              <div class="lsw-seg lsw-bg-bs" ng-if="row.bs" ng-style="{width: row.bW}"></div>
              <div class="lsw-seg lsw-bg-req" ng-if="row.r" ng-style="{width: row.rW}"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p class="lsw-muted" ng-if="!c.rows.length">No active license subscriptions.</p>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="lsw-card lsw-trend" aria-labelledby="lsw-trend-h">
        <div>
          <h2 class="lsw-h2" id="lsw-trend-h">Unused licenses</h2>
          <p class="lsw-muted lsw-small">Users acting as Requester, last {{c.data.weeks.length}} weeks</p>
        </div>
        <div ng-if="c.trend.enough">
          <div class="lsw-kpi-row">
            <span class="lsw-trend-n lsw-c-req">{{c.trend.last | number}}</span>
            <span class="lsw-muted">from {{c.trend.first | number}} on {{c.trend.labels[0]}}</span>
          </div>
          <svg class="lsw-chart" viewBox="0 0 600 180" preserveAspectRatio="none" role="img" aria-label="{{c.trend.aria}}">
            <line x1="0" y1="170" x2="600" y2="170" class="lsw-axis" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"></line>
            <line x1="0" y1="95" x2="600" y2="95" class="lsw-grid" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"></line>
            <line x1="0" y1="20" x2="600" y2="20" class="lsw-grid" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"></line>
            <polygon ng-attr-points="{{c.trend.area}}" class="lsw-area"></polygon>
            <polyline ng-attr-points="{{c.trend.line}}" class="lsw-line" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"></polyline>
          </svg>
          <div class="lsw-axis-labels"><span ng-repeat="l in c.trend.labels track by $index">{{l}}</span></div>
        </div>
        <p class="lsw-muted" ng-if="!c.trend.enough">The trend appears after scans in two different weeks.</p>
      </section>
    </div>

    <section class="lsw-card" aria-labelledby="lsw-review-h">
      <div class="lsw-card-head">
        <div>
          <h2 class="lsw-h2" id="lsw-review-h">Users to review</h2>
          <p class="lsw-muted lsw-small">Hold a Fulfiller license but did not fulfil anything in the last {{c.data.lookbackDays}} days</p>
        </div>
        <a class="lsw-link" ng-if="c.kpi.reviewTotal" ng-href="{{c.reviewLink}}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View all {{c.kpi.reviewTotal | number}}</a>
      </div>
      <div class="lsw-table-wrap" ng-if="c.review.length">
        <table class="lsw-table">
          <thead>
            <tr><th scope="col">User</th><th scope="col">Subscription</th><th scope="col">Acting as</th><th scope="col">Evidence</th></tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            <tr ng-repeat="u in c.review">
              <td class="lsw-strong">{{u.user}}</td>
              <td>{{u.subName}}</td>
              <td><span class="lsw-act" ng-class="u.acting === 'Requester' ? 'lsw-act-req' : 'lsw-act-bs'">{{u.acting}}</span></td>
              <td class="lsw-muted">{{u.evidence}}</td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      <p class="lsw-muted" ng-if="!c.review.length">Nobody to review in this selection.</p>
    </section>
  </div>
</div>
]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>
